question.trigger_rationale: The actual IsSingleton implementation checks voter cardinality only. switchToConfig can leave a demoted node in StateLeader, whereas the shortcut comment assumes the sole voter is the leader. The public ReadOnlySafe contract requires quorum communication; an installed learner is not that quorum. Fully applying a demotion avoids the early-Advance ambiguity. A two-node protocol history is small enough to execute actual election, replication and configuration application instead of injecting a role.

obligation.description: In ReadOnlySafe mode, completing a ReadIndex request through the singleton shortcut without a quorum-confirmation round requires that the local responding node be the sole voter in its installed configuration. A retained learner leader with a different sole voter must not complete the request using only its local state.

scope.description: Eligibility of the local-only ReadOnlySafe shortcut after a fully applied leader-to-learner demotion, with StepDownOnRemoval disabled.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine peers and immutable unique IDs.
Configuration change is committed using the prior configuration and applied in order.
Caller persists Ready state before sends and calls ApplyConfChange before Advance.
Read request uses a fresh unique context; no incoming voter message is delivered after invocation.
excluded: A requirement that every read must complete.
Global linearizability endpoint without a separate observed client history.

grounding.derivation: The Config ReadOnlySafe contract guarantees linearizability by quorum communication. Its singleton optimization is documented as the one voting member being the leader. Installed voter sets define who can contribute quorum support; a learner outside the singleton cannot substitute local state for the actual voter. This obligation checks that eligibility condition, not eventual read completion or an equality between leadership and success.
grounding.applicability: The host completes configuration installation normally. The implementation option permits retaining the old leader role, but does not weaken ReadOnlySafe. Scope selects a retained learner rather than relying on the duties of a host after complete node removal.
alternatives: Enabled StepDownOnRemoval transitions the demoted node to follower.
The node could safely leave a read pending or forward it to a current leader instead of returning a local result.
